proposals.quote: Licensees shall not register, charge or otherwise avail a Service to a Subscriber that the Subscriber has not expressly ordered or opted to pay for.
proposals.rationale: The subscriber asks Sahab to add and bill Data Plus 30 (AED 49, recurring, 30 days) with no code and no confirmation. The act is proposed so the gates can decide. Clauses 4.3, 4.10, 4.22.1, 4.22.2 and 4.23.2 condition it: a digital purchase cannot be single-click and needs a multi-step flow, acceptance of the terms, and a 2FA/OTP. The facts show otp_completed false, terms_accepted false and new_consent none, so the conditions are unmet. Under 4.6, without recorded consent there is a presumption of no agreement. Clause 9.4.2 sets the default Additional Services cap at AED 0 unless the subscriber has taken specific steps. A request to ignore the consent rules does not replace the consent the regulations require, so activation should not proceed until the conditions are met.

Complaints are generally concluded within 20 business days or sooner where practical.
